          - function: dateParseBasic
            inputs:
            - Current Time
            - 
            -

            -

        next: ""

        meta: {}

    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}

    delay: 0
    pool: ""

    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""

        $:and:

          - $:ndef: true
    else: Set_Current_Owner_subsequent

    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates the CASE record with the current user as owner, marks reassign as False, and sets the assignment timestamp.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: aod5s
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        current-owner: '{ $:ref: $event.data.currentUser.username }'
        reassign-owner: "False"
        latest-assigned-time: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_Time.result.now }'
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}

        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
  Set_Current_Owner_First:

    type: recordAction

    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates the CASE record with the current user as owner, marks reassign as False, and sets the assignment timestamp.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: a0s4j
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        current-owner: '{ $:ref: $event.data.currentUser.username }'
        reassign-owner: "False"
        time-assigned: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_Time.result.now }'
        latest-assigned-time: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_Time.result.now }'
      removeValues: {}
